hooks.description: Auto-format TS/TSX files with Prettier after edits in extend/

hooks.command: powershell -Command "$f='%FILE_PATH%'; if($f -match '(locales\\(en|zh-CN)\.json|shared\\types\.d\.s|tracker\.db)') { Write-Error 'Protected file - confirm before editing'; exit 1 } else { exit 0 }"
hooks.description: Protect sensitive files (locale JSONs, shared types, SQLite DB) from accidental edits
